name: neon-vault
description: A modular virtual-credit casino and progression game built with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

scripts.check: find src -name '*.js' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 node --check && node --check sw.js && node --check playwright.config.js
scripts.test:all: npm run check && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:e2e
